text:
You need a Shopify e-commerce launch that can quickly test a 1-product magic store with three landing pages, using your existing brand direction, content, GIFs, images, and artwork to create a polished experience that drives traffic and conversions.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be a strong fit for this kind of focused build. I have 7 years of experience working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS, and I’m comfortable turning a clear brief into a clean, responsive, conversion-focused storefront. For a short-term experiment like this, speed, clarity, and execution matter a lot — especially when the goal is to validate a product concept before expanding into a larger site.

What stands out in your brief is that the structure is already well thought out. That makes this a great project for building a strong front end around your provided assets and page content, while making sure the pages feel cohesive, branded, and optimized for a simple sales flow. I can help shape the three landing pages so they feel consistent, load well, and guide visitors toward the product without unnecessary friction.

I also understand that this is only the first phase. Since the next stage may include selling products and courses plus a community area, I’d approach this build with a clean foundation in mind so the site can evolve naturally later. Even for a small initial experiment, it’s important to set up the experience in a way that won’t need to be rebuilt from scratch when you expand.

If helpful, I can work closely from your mapped-out page plan and asset folders to make sure each section is implemented accurately and with attention to detail. I’m happy to keep the process straightforward and focused on delivering exactly what the brief calls for.

What platform or Shopify setup are you planning to use for this first 1-product test?
